stock.description: Nanshan Aluminium International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, with its core operations centered on the production and distribution of alumina across Southeast Asia. The company's product portfolio includes various forms of alumina, specifically aluminum hydroxide. Beyond its primary manufacturing activities, it also provides management consulting services. Its clientele consists of aluminum manufacturers and commodity dealers who utilize its products for the creation of electrolytic aluminum. Established in 2017, the firm is based in Bintan, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary under Nanshan Aluminium Investment Holding Limited.
